headline: What Do Boston Scientific (BSX) Recalls Mean For Device Safety And Clinical Use?
summary: Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) has initiated multiple product recalls covering cardiac ablation generators and vascular access sheaths due to labeling discrepancies and air embolism risks. The recalls affect a broad mix of devices used in cardiac and vascular procedures across several international markets. Regulators and hospitals are assessing the implications for device safety protocols, clinical workflows, and future use of the impacted products. Product safety questions can prompt...
